entities.summary: Giovanni Pontano (1426–1503), later known as Giovanni Gioviano, was a humanist and poet from Cerreto di Spoleto, in central Italy. He was the leading figure of the Accademia Pontaniana after the death of Antonio Beccadelli in 1471, and the academy took his name.
